name: progress
title: Progress
description: A thin well that fills with ink as work completes.
use: How much of a task is done: an upload, a build, a count of steps. Without a value the amount is unknown and the bar is indeterminate. The bar does not print its number: write it beside the label. progress-ring draws the same amount around a circle, for a tile, a row or the corner of a card.

instead.when: It is a measurement within a range, such as storage used or a score, not a task that completes
The length is unknown and the place is a button or another small space
Content is loading and its shape is known
The task is a few named steps and the reader should see which one is current

platform.feature: Typed attr(), as in attr(aria-valuenow type(<number>))
platform.fallback: The ring does not read aria-valuenow and aria-valuemax: set --progress-ring-value in a style attribute as well, and --progress-ring-max when the maximum is not 100

classes.name: progress
classes.description: A progress bar, on a native progress element with a label: a 6px track that fills with ink and eases to each new value. The text inside the element is a fallback

classes.name: progress-sm
classes.description: A 4px track, for a row in a list; the default is 6px

classes.name: progress-segmented
classes.description: The track in --progress-steps equal pieces, five by default, for a count of things. Set --progress-steps to the same number as max

classes.name: progress-ring
classes.description: A ring, 40px across, on an element with role="progressbar", an accessible name and the amount in aria-valuenow. The element's own content is the label in the middle

classes.name: progress-ring-xl
classes.description: A 96px ring with a larger figure in the middle; the default is 40px

states.name: indeterminate
states.description: The element has no value attribute: a band of ink travels along the track, and with reduced motion the track rests at an even half tone

states.name: value
states.description: The amount, out of aria-valuemax or 100. Without aria-valuenow the amount is unknown and a quarter arc travels the track

properties.name: --progress-steps
properties.description: Number of pieces of a segmented track; set it to the same number as max

properties.name: --progress-ring-value
properties.description: The ring's amount. It comes from aria-valuenow where typed attr() is supported; set it by hand elsewhere

properties.name: --progress-ring-max
properties.description: The amount of a full ring. It comes from aria-valuemax where typed attr() is supported; set it by hand elsewhere

properties.name: --progress-ring-width
properties.description: The ring's thickness: a tenth of the size, and 2px at least

properties.name: --progress-ring-color
properties.description: The arc's color; set it to a status color when the ring reports one

example:
<label class="field">
  Uploading 3 of 5 files
  <progress class="progress" value="62" max="100">62%</progress>
</label>
